purpose: Localize the Stage-3 discrepancy between the paper's near-zero unmodulated Arithmetic KL claim and the executable 26-bit author implementation before the full Figure-3 sweep.

arithmetic_point.note: This is a diagnostic sweep of the paper's near-unmodified Arithmetic point. It is not a new Figure-3 parameter grid and must not replace the frozen paper reproduction matrix.

payload.reason: A long deterministic uniform bitstream keeps almost all coding steps free of implicit zero lookahead even at precision=48. Summary statistics separately report only steps with zero implicit lookahead.

instrumentation.author_residual_fill_semantics: The pinned 2019/current author code adds the integer shortfall to the whole cumulative vector; after differencing this assigns the shortfall to the first candidate bin.
instrumentation.counterfactual_terminal_fill_semantics: Diagnostic only: assign the same integer shortfall to the final candidate bin, without using this distribution for token selection.
instrumentation.truncation_only_semantics: Diagnostic only: renormalize the pre-rounding LM probabilities over the actually retained candidate prefix.

parity_check.note: The instrumented mirror is accepted only if it reproduces the pinned executable reference on a sentinel run before the diagnostic sweep is trusted.

interpretation_policy.reason: The probe is designed to diagnose the discrepancy rather than force the data to match the paper claim.
